title: 4.9 Luis worked on Saturday
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say what people did and did not do on a day of the week (Luis worked on Saturday. / He didn't work on Sunday.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.9 Days of the Week: A1 names the days; A1+ 4.9 says what people did on them. The new items are the past with on + a day (Luis worked on Saturday.), with the three -ed sounds heard in worked and watched (t) and painted (an extra syllable), and didn't + the base verb for what did not happen (He didn't work on Sunday.), the past form of 1.8's doesn't. A day cannot be photographed: each photo shows what its person does, and Listen sets the days against each other and the past against the present and the negative. A didn't line is never set against a photo that shows the activity, and a No answer uses A1 4.8's photo of Ana's thumb down. Luis works (A1+ 1.1's workday photo) and watches TV (1.8), Ana works, Diego works in his office (2.1) and paints (3.14).
prerequisite: A1 4.9 the days; A1+ 1.8 doesn't; A1+ 4.7 -ed; A1+ 4.8 Did…?.
speaking_outcome: worked and watched end in t (WURKT, WOCHT); painted has two syllables (PAIN-tid); didn't is one beat. Do not require native-like speed.
